item.title: Re: My First SCP Idea
item.content:encoded: i don't know if my brief description really did it justice tbh, I kind of am bad at just bringing stuff down to its core and explaining just that, I do have a sandbox though if you'd like to see it: http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/gojira1150

item.title: Re: My First SCP Idea
item.content:encoded: Iunno, this doesn't really vibe with me as is. Like, you're really trying to write an interesting short story here: the plane rebuilding and there being a threat of stuff happening if it succeeds isn't an awful idea (though it feels somewhat reminiscent of SCP-682) but it's a base for the story: you're going to have to figure out y'know, what the Foundation do to prevent this and how you can show this challenge in an interesting way to readers; and like, how the challenge can escalate in stakes so that you can reach this final, thrilling conclusion.

item.title: Re: My First SCP Idea
item.content:encoded: Sorry, I'll trim it down to its concept

item.title: Re: My First SCP Idea
item.content:encoded: A draft taken from a sandbox isn't really the best look for a concept, a concept is usually just the main plot points, not really something like this. I'd recommend you trim it down so it is more preferable to read

item.title: My First SCP Idea
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: History

Elevator Pitch: The Red Baron's plane, which originally landed itself but was torn apart before the Foundation could get to it. Later on the Foundation learned that the plane was slowly rebuilding itself

Central Narrative: Trying to keep the pieces of the Red Baron's plane away from each other so the plane can't rebuild itself

Hook/Attention-Grabber: If the plane rebuilds itself, it will take off and strafe the surrounding area

Additional Notes: None right now
